name: edenai-docs-integration-clis
description: The coding agent CLIs the integration pages configure, run by tests/test_integration_clis.py with the settings each page gives them. Kept apart from tests/package.json because together they unpack to about a gigabyte of platform binaries that only that one test needs. Versions are pinned exactly and the lockfile is committed, so a run tests the docs rather than whatever npm resolved that morning.
